target.title: fix(tui): handle live session message updates
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #38829. The Gateway already broadcasts `session.message` when another client appends a displayable transcript entry, but the running TUI ignored that event. The selected transcript therefore stayed stale until a manual reload or session switch.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Dispatches the existing event through a typed TUI handler; no Gateway protocol or subscription surface changes.
- Routes idle external invalidations through the TUI's one canonical serialized history queue instead of adding a second reload coordinator.
- Defers invalidations during active, pending, or optimistic local runs until both local execution is idle and the terminal persistence event has arrived. Either event ordering is supported.
- Captures the selected session and agent across async history and session-info loads, so an old response cannot repaint a newly selected session.
- Coalesces bursts into at most one follow-up reload while preserving invalidations that arrive during an in-flight load.

This is a current-shape rewrite of the original contribution. The earlier version handled the event but duplicated newer run-aware reload state and did not fully protect against stale async results after selection changes.

## User Impact

Messages sent from another OpenClaw surface appear in an already-running TUI without a restart. Local streaming/final output remains visible until the persisted transcript is authoritative, and switching sessions cannot be undone by a late response from the old selection.

## Evidence

Exact rewritten head: `b0253c29756bc7fca22a09a7bc495ef5f03de654`.

- Sanitized AWS Crabbox `cbx_3c73747f4601`, run `run_c23cbeab4a86`: original event-handler/session-action baseline, 124 tests passed.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwxhf00awefzyke5p0phz686`: rewritten event-handler/session-action suites, 141 tests passed.
- Same Testbox: `pnpm check:test-types` passed; `OPENCLAW_TUI_PTY_INCLUDE_LOCAL=1 pnpm test src/tui/tui-pty-local.e2e.test.ts` passed, 9/9.
- Source-blind live validation: ran the public TUI against an isolated Gateway, used a second public Gateway client to call `sessions.send`, and observed the unique marker appear in the running transcript without restart, direct state mutation, or test-only event injection.
- Regression coverage includes event scoping, reload coalescing, active-run deferral, both terminal/persistence orderings, run-less invalidations, and stale session/agent responses.
- Fresh structured autoreview: clean, no actionable findings, confidence 0.84.

Hosted exact-head CI passed in [run 28846887328](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28846887328), and the repo-native `OPENCLAW_TESTBOX=1 scripts/pr prepare-run 96252` gate accepted this exact head. The PR is intentionally left unmerged for maintainer review.

## Risk / Compatibility

No config, storage, provider, protocol, or plugin SDK changes. Risk is confined to TUI transcript refresh ordering. The rewrite keeps one history-reload owner and makes the run/persistence barrier and selection identity explicit.

## AI Assistance

AI-assisted rewrite and review. The maintainer inspected the full event, history-loading, run-terminal, Gateway subscription, and real PTY paths.
